summary: The agent demonstrates a sophisticated modeling approach with robust stacking cross-validation and extensive feature engineering. However, the solution is fundamentally compromised by critical data leakage: all data imputation, feature transformations (TF-IDF, SVD), target/frequency encodings, and spatial aggregations are computed globally on the combined train and test set before splitting.
